newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - B. Stearns ups Intel on EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - B. Stearns ups Intel on EPS.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Andy Neff said he had raised his earnings estimates on Intel Corp for the 1996 and 1997 year.
-- Neff said he pushed up his 1996 year earnings estimate to $5.30 per share from $4.85 previously and his 1997 year view to $7.00 per share from $5.90 per share previously.
-- He declined to state what his target price is on the stock, which has appreciated signinificantly in the past week.
-- Intel was trading at 112-1/8, up 4-1/2 on the day Tuesday after reporting third quarter earnings far above Wall Street analysts' consensus expectations late Monday.
